sec.title: August 29 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 351)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 29** across American network radio and syndication, Country Music Hall of Famer Red Foley singing gospel harmonies and country-boogie hits for Tide on *The Tide Show* (1945–1951), Stuart Erwin's apartment sublet misadventures on *Phone Again Finnegan* (1946), Freddie Martin's big band swing on *Wednesdays with You* for Raleigh Cigarettes (1945), and Myrtle Vail's vaudeville drama *Myrt and Marge* (1945–1951):
